scenario: A museum is displaying seven sculptures — Arch, Basin, Crest, Dome, Edge, Flint, and Grove — across three consecutive wings: North, Center, and South. Each wing contains either two or three sculptures. Within each wing, the sculptures are arranged in a strict left-to-right visible order and are assigned positions 1 (leftmost) through 3 (rightmost) within that wing, though a wing with only two sculptures uses only positions 1 and 2. The following conditions govern the display.

rules.comment: Arch is not the leftmost sculpture in the North wing
Basin appears before Crest in the overall left-to-right ordering
Dome is not in the Center wing's leftmost position (position 3 overall)
Dome is not in Center position 2 (position 4 overall)
Dome is not in the Center wing at all — must be North or South
If Edge is in South position 1, then Flint is in South position 2
Grove and Arch are not adjacent in the display
